area_sampling: 49 evenly spaced disk grid points within spot; excludes overlapping labels
patient_aggregation: equal mean of eligible section effects; author patient grouping
tests: two-sided exact sign test across >=3 nonzero patient effects; no spot-level P; nominal P, no FDR per user preference
registration: H&E SIFT + affine RANSAC; >=20 inliers, >=35% inlier fraction, median error <=1.5 lowres pixels, second-target <65%; reciprocal source best >2x runner-up; explicit capture suffix exact
